# Trap-Wise Drill: at war with a kobold country or one of the Dragon Cult.
DA_GN_trap_drill = {
	potential = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Trap_Drill }
	trigger = {
		is_at_war = yes
		DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
		any_war_enemy_country = {
			OR = {
				DA_RH_primary_kobold = yes
				religion = kobold_dragon_cult
			}
		}
	}
	morale_damage = 0.1
	land_attrition = -0.1
}
